body: filemark task system is 'parse once, many consumers': MDXViewer calls extractTasks(body) once per file (useMemo on content), wraps the tree in TasksProvider. TaskItem/TaskCheckbox/TaskList/TaskStats/KanbanFromTasks/TaskTimeline all read TasksContext — zero re-parse. Task<->line correlation uses react-markdown's node.position.start.line (the 'node' prop, stripped from DOM output), NOT id-hashes, so it survives file reloads.
